# Toledo Holistic Healthcare

> Holistic chiropractic, acupuncture, and wellness clinic in Toledo, Ohio serving NW Ohio with a whole-body, patient-centered approach.

## About

Toledo Holistic Healthcare (Toledo Holistic Healthcare LLC) is a holistic health clinic located at 2828 W Central Ave, Suite 1, Toledo, OH 43606. Tagline: "We Take A Whole Body Approach To Your Healthcare."

Lead practitioner: Dr. Jared Mainous, DC (Doctor of Chiropractic) — performs chiropractic adjustments and acupuncture.

Team:
- Dr. Jared Mainous, DC — Chiropractor / Acupuncturist
- Aleshia — Licensed Massage Therapist (owner of 10 Eleven Massage)
- Lori C. — Office Administrator

## Services

- Chiropractic
- Massage Therapy
- Acupuncture
- Cupping
- Fertility (chiropractic support for reproductive health)
- Pregnancy (prenatal chiropractic care)
- Electrical Muscle Stimulation
- Cold Laser Therapy
- Electro-Meridian Imaging

## Conditions Treated

- Back Pain
- Neck Pain
- Headaches
- Auto Injuries
- Sports Injuries
- Work Injuries
- Fertility

## Insurance

Works with most insurances including private insurance for car accidents and workers compensation. Works with Veteran's Affairs. Reasonable fee base when coverage is absent.

## New Patients

Yes, accepting new patients. Care provided for ALL ages, from newborn babies to mature retirees.
